variants.prompt: REFORM OUTFIT/ATTIRE: In a dimly lit, candle-lit chamber, she stands before a velvet curtain, the black leather jacket and red dress now replaced with sheer black lace lingerie. The delicate fabric clings to her olive-toned skin, highlighting every curve as a pair of stiletto heels add height. Her raven-black hair falls in loose waves down her back, while her smoldering amber eyes hold a playful, teasing smile as she looks directly at the camera. A DSLR captures her in a cinematic, shallow focus shot with the curtain and candlelight creating a romantic, intimate ambiance.
